text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, while eating with Symboli<n>Rudolf...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah... That was delectable.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I see that she's folded her<n>hamburger wrapper into
a neat<n>square. There isn't a single stain<n>around her
mouth either.
choice_data_list:
Wow, you don't make a mess even when eating
burgers.

Wow, you don't make a mess even when eating
burgers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that unusual?
choice_data_list: It's usually not quite so pretty for the rest of us...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I point out that her table manners are<n>impeccable
when she eats, to which<n>she replies...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha... If you ever happen to meet<n>any of my older
siblings, you'll be<n>even more surprised.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They are the very picture of etiquette.<n>When I was
little, I would always<n>copy their behavior.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe, no. I have a younger sister.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I had to act the part of the<n>responsible older sister
to avoid<n>setting a poor example for her.
choice_data_list: I'm sure she's grown into a fine young lady.
I'm sure she's grown into a fine young lady.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh yes, she's our pride and joy.<n>Although, that
isn't all...

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Father
text_block_list.text:
Have you decided on your New<n>Year's resolution,
Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Father! I spoke to Brother and<n>Sister about it
and I've made my<n>decision!

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, very good. Then, let us offer our<n>prayers. First,
bow your head...

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Look, a shrine maiden! Your clothes<n>are so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! Listen, the shrine<n>maiden is really
busy right now. Let's<n>not disturb her.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's quite all right. Besides, I<n>remember
speaking with you both<n>last year as well. Would the
two of<n>you like to draw fortune slips after<n>you've
prayed?

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Ehehe, I can't believe you<n>remember me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She was the type to disappear all of a<n>sudden, then
come back with a new<n>friend in tow. Yes, that
sunny smile of<n>hers is wonderful, indeed. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, Big Sis! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There you are! What are you doing<n>dancing with the
lion dancers?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...She was often at the center of some<n>ruckus. I
think that's why I did my<n>best to keep hold of her
hand<n>whenever we went out.
choice_data_list: She does sound like a handful...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, a handful and a troublemaker.<n>But thanks to
her...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Mom! The water went everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry for my daughter's<n>behavior! I
hope your clothes didn't<n>get wet... O-oh dear, your
shoes!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. It's quite all right.<n>You've got quite a
lively little girl<n>there.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clang!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Mom, I dropped my spoon too.

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Why are you throwing things?!<n>Please behave
yourself...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. Hey, take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hippity-hop.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What do bunny ears do?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Flap!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Flippity-flap! And bunny legs?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hippity-hop!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: They certainly do. One more time?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hippity-hop! Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, now she can make a bunny<n>with her hands
too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, that's big sisters for you.<n>I used every
trick in the book to get<n>my younger sister to behave.
choice_data_list: ...I can tell you're a very caring sister.
...I can tell you're a very caring sister.
I bet you'd make a great mother too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, that's big sisters for you.<n>I used every
trick in the book to get<n>my younger sister to behave.
choice_data_list: ...I can tell you're a very caring sister.
...I can tell you're a very caring sister.
I bet you'd make a great mother too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I do understand that one<n>must be strict
when necessary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...After all, there's nothing quite so<n>cute as an
innocent child.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Mamma mia. Me? A mama?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...One day, perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But they do say "spare the rod, spoil<n>the child." If it
were my own daughter,<n>though—well, who knows?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf smiles warmly,<n>perhaps with some
of her juniors in<n>mind.
